subject.title: fix(whatsapp): normalize hosted JIDs consistently with Baileys

question: Should OpenClaw adopt the verified-mapping-only migration for existing WhatsApp LID allowlists, with unresolved entries retained but no longer authorized until an operator replaces them with E.164 values?
rationale: This is an intentional authorization and upgrade-policy choice affecting existing WhatsApp installations; source review can establish the mechanics, but not whether the fail-closed operator experience is the permanent product contract.

options.title: Accept guarded migration
options.body: Merge the canonical JID model with verified mappings migrated automatically and unresolved or conflicting LID entries warned and left for manual repair.

options.title: Preserve existing LID authorization
options.body: Require a different compatibility design that retains existing LID-form allowlist authorization until an explicit migration is completed.

options.title: Narrow the PR
options.body: Land only the non-policy JID normalization work and track authorization migration as a separately sponsored decision.

recommendation.title: Accept guarded migration
recommendation.body: Merge the canonical JID model with verified mappings migrated automatically and unresolved or conflicting LID entries warned and left for manual repair.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the repository-member contributor with the most direct implementation context for the proposed JID and migration contract.
